Delta and Air France welcome you aboard BusinessElite®,
, where your need
for convenience, comfort and premium service is recognized. We invite you to
sit back and enjoy a variety of international flavors designed for your pleasure.
To complement your meal and enhance your dining enjoyment, we are proud
to suggest a wine from our award-winning VINUM collection. Please ask
your flight attendant for today's featured selections.
Thank you for choosing BusinessElite.
IDEAL PERFORMANCE MEALS
Delta has partnered with LGE Performance Systems to develop choices
which help travelers on board and upon arrival.

and be alert for meetings you may have upon arrival.
To arrive refreshed at your destination, Delta recommends drinking plenty
of water and moving around every hour or so. Setting your watch to the new
time zone and adapting to local eating and sleeping habits will also
enhance your comfort.
For more information, contact training and nutrition specialists

eyersipping
It was only five years ago that we introduced Cybersipping to the aviation world. It
was so exciting to find web sites that could teach wine. I thought those sites were
unbelievable, and now at a frightening speed five years later web sites on wine
number are in the ten thousands. Our goal was to bring you the best to make
your wine education more fun, especially if you travel a lot and sometimes find
yourself stuck in a hotel with time on your hands. You could go on line and study
wine all day long! There are now so many incredible sites for you to choose from;
a new one appears every day. As an educator this is music to my ears!
Here are two great sites that you should bookmark.
www.wineeducation.org
I like this site because it caters to both beginners and advanced students of the
grape. The site has been around for about eight years and takes a nice and easy
approach to the joy of learning about wine. You get the sense that there is some
passion behind this site.
www.drinkwine.com
This professionally done site has it all, from winery directories to travel in wine
country. It is well laid out and easy to follow and read. Gives you wine clubs to
join and the latest news in the business. You can ask questions on wine and get
answers. Very practical.

We hope you have enjoyed the wine and art selection presented in this edition
of Vinum. We are fortunate to have such talent in Georgia and are pleased to
include the following quotes from each regarding their inspiration. Look for more
opportunities to enjoy Vinum wines and art throughout the year!
Artists
Rachael Buffington Baldanza-Remembered, 2001
"Every decision I make as a painter leads to the next one, but I am most inspired by
the rich colors in the world around me, stories of how we interact as people, and any
extraordinary acts of creativity and kindness."
www.rbuffington.com
Anke Schofield-Red Integrity
"In my current work I am involved in creating a bold sense of space and form,
adding memoirs of collected objects and capturing a true sense of color."
www.ankeschofield.com
Jeff LangeRed Bridge Reflection
"Life and art is an ongoing process that shapes our perspective in multiple facets."
www.langeart.com
Chris Culver-Divergent Paths #2
"The coalescence of various ideas, experiences, colors, images, feelings and
constructed environments is how our imaginations provide us happiness and, in
two dimensions, blend the experience of the 'art' of Art and Architecture."
678 665-1022
June McCoy Ball—Sensuous Themes from the Piedmont; Dissolved By Light
"The abstract relationships between shapes and colors in the natural world
challenge and fascinate me. My paintings are more felt responses to cherished
places than they are precise depictions of them."
http://June.niteowl.org
Dixie Taylor Purvis-Unwrapped
"My paintings describe connections both hidden and revealed-connections that
define who we are or might become."
404 352-2288 or Momus Gallery at 404 355-4180
Ray Pierotti-Alaskan Goldenmean
"My work is firmly rooted in the material world of particle physics; spiritually I
am inclined towards Eastern mysticism. Current subjects are landscapes which
are as much about the soul as that of a place. Scenes remembered and invented
commingle like memorable lives."
www.absoluteart.com/portfolios/r/raypierotti
Bryan E. Schellinger-Deep Down Under
"I paint for the sheer enjoyment of the visual experience and it's ability to transform
you to a state of present moment awareness, uninhibited by time or place-allowing
one to take a voyage without physically traveling."
www.absolutearts.com/abryan or www.momusgallery.com
